data.name: Aafa
data.gender_notes: Aafa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Afa’ which means to be free from sin or to have honor and dignity. In Islamic history, Aafa was the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for her generosity and kindness. The name Aafa carries the meaning “Honor or Dignity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aafa usually hope their child will grow to embody honor or dignity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aafa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Honor or Dignity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
